prompts.name: painter-mischief
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one wide 16:9 fantasy game painting. Reference image is for the existing character and colorful hand-painted pixel-art storybook style only. Same clearly adult 25-year-old woodland nymph, long copper-red curls, pointed ears, green eyes, flowers in hair. All other characters are adults. Humorous mischievous fantasy adventure, expressive faces, warm rich colors, clear silhouettes readable at 320x144. Fully opaque clothing. No nudity, lingerie, sexual activity, erotic framing, text, borders or watermark. In an elderly goblin master painter's woodland studio, the nymph wears an elegant opaque green off-shoulder leaf gown, sitting backwards on a wooden chair with her arms resting across its back, flashing a bold knowing grin at the painter. The elderly goblin in a paint-splattered smock and beret looks comically flustered while painting her as an absurdly solemn saint with a halo on his canvas. The comic mismatch tells us the prince's supposedly gentle innocent sweetheart has a cheeky rebellious personality. Include easel, brushes and golden woodland light. Wide medium shot showing both adults and canvas.
